ModuleCreate/UpdateSerializer uses members/lead, requires module_view, filters nonempty members to project members, validates date order only when both dates are supplied. Create duplicate-name error includes id/code/error/message; PATCH duplicate-name error has only error. View-level external identifier collisions return 409. Member children collect all shape and missing-user failures at their original indices before object/date validation. Empty strings normalize to null errors. The accepted composite-child correction rejects list/dict values with DRF incorrect_type messages before UUID conversion or rendering; scalar behavior is unchanged.
Create returns ModuleSerializer; PATCH returns ModuleUpdateSerializer data. Preserve different field sets and DateField values.

Persist accepted fields and audit values. Defaults apply only to creation; PUT preserves omitted optional fields. On create, sort_order is the existing project minimum minus 10000 when live rows exist, otherwise the explicit value or model default. Omitted members preserve membership; explicit empty clears existing membership; replacement soft-deletes existing through rows and bulk-creates requested members, preserving other modules.

Create/PATCH emit model_activity after save, including requested_data and prior serialized current_instance on PATCH; inherited PUT emits no model_activity. Member replacement retains source soft-delete effects. API-key requests also update token bookkeeping and publish process_logs, including denied/invalid requests after authentication.

projection_policy: Sparse corrected Django fixtures override pristine fixtures by family and case ID; unchanged cases use the pristine fixture. Corrections are reconstructed from the pinned Django tree independently of Go.

differential_replay.environment: Production Caddy differential uses isolated source/candidate database clones, Redis DB12/13 and dedicated RabbitMQ vhosts. Both sides seed module-lifecycle-proxy/project030103 with modules enabled. Fixture replay separately uses Redis DB11 and RabbitMQ /module_lifecycle; no worker runs during request parity.
